policy: Done means accepted by the developer. A private preview is not a shipped feature. No release dates are promised.

cards.title: Dinosaur boss animation
cards.summary: T-rex motion and combat review is ready. Triceratops now has a first exported quadruped gait under review; the remaining dinosaur bosses follow.
cards.next: Review planted strides, head tracking, attack weight, sound and gameplay interactions in actual play.

cards.title: Cinematics and replay gallery
cards.summary: Opening and progression cinematics are complete, with unlocked scenes available in the gallery.
cards.next: Completed and accepted by the developer.

cards.title: Main-menu redesign
cards.summary: Official logo, new button artwork, ambient mist and flickering lights are in place.

cards.title: Discoveries grid
cards.summary: Large categorized grid with unlock states and a dedicated detail panel.

cards.title: Early Compy stampedes
cards.summary: Early stampedes rush through the battlefield and push creatures and survivors.

cards.title: Boss-defeat respite
cards.summary: A short pause in new spawns gives the battlefield a moment to breathe.

cards.title: T-rex final play review
cards.summary: New rig, pursuit, directional attacks, pressure waves and heavy sound are ready for review.
cards.next: Developer acceptance and a final playtest are still required before a public build.

cards.title: Soundtrack polish
cards.summary: Map and boss themes are in game; further production and musical polish remain open.
cards.next: Refine balance, orchestration and transitions through in-game listening.

cards.title: Interface polish
cards.summary: Continue checking readability, button sizing and consistency across screens.
cards.next: Keep frames and text clear at supported window sizes.

cards.title: Horde difficulty and experience
cards.summary: Tune spawn density so hordes pose a stronger threat and reward more experience.
cards.next: Validate early pressure, progression and performance together.

cards.title: Level-up sound
cards.summary: Replace the notification-like cue with a satisfying fantasy level-up sound.
cards.next: Needs approval after repeated listening in gameplay.

cards.title: Flametorch and Rift Conduit
cards.summary: Targeted flowing flame and plasma tether prototypes are on hold during the boss pass.
cards.next: Resume fluid animation, sound, upgrade-path cards and balance after bosses.

cards.title: Scoreboard redesign
cards.summary: Bring run statistics into the current UI style with clear framed sections.
cards.next: Define text fitting and support long names, large totals and older records.

cards.title: Companion naming and statistics
cards.summary: Procedural names that persist for an individual companion and appear in run history.
cards.next: Use component-based generation and separate display names from internal IDs.

cards.title: Additional permanent research
cards.summary: Expand permanent upgrades with progression-aware presentation.
cards.next: Keep undiscovered entries as silhouettes without revealing their details.

cards.title: Linux compatibility verification
cards.summary: A Linux archive is available; runtime compatibility is not yet verified.
cards.next: Test actual Linux gameplay before calling it supported.

devlog.title: Triceratops takes its first steps
devlog.body: A dedicated four-legged rig now animates the painted Triceratops reconstruction. The first walk and run clips have been exported and inspected in Godot. Ground contact, turning and attack weight remain under review; this is not yet a public gameplay replacement.

devlog.title: A heavier predator, and a clearer development board
devlog.body: The T-rex motion pass now covers pursuit, turns, bite, rush, tail gust, roar pressure wave and seismic stomp. It remains a development preview awaiting final play review. The remaining boss animation work follows next. Cinematics are accepted as complete; beam prototypes are paused while bosses take priority.
